simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אוּבָל (H180) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אוּבָל (ʼûwbâl) means a stream First listed occurrence: Dan 8 2.

definitions.full: H180. ubal אוּבַל noun [masculine] stream, river (= יוּבַל ) — only אוּלָ֑י אוּבַל Dan 8:2 the river Ulai.
definitions.rootNote: or (shortened) אֻבָל ; from 2986 (in the sense of 2988 );
